content: ## Football Stadium Gallery's Post. ### **Football Stadium Gallery** is in **Bremen, Germany**. Weserstadion, Bremen - SV Werder Bremen. Weserstadion is a football stadium in Bremen, Germany. The Weserstadion is scenically situated on the north bank of the Weser River and is surrounded by lush green parks (the name 'Werder' is a regional German word for "river peninsula"). It is the home stadium of German Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Opened in 1924, this oldest stadium has a capacity of around 42,100-43,087 spectators, provides luxurious VIP rooms, and serves as a hub for sporting and music events. Long History: The stadium has been used by SV Werder Bremen since 1909, making it one of the oldest sporting venues in Germany. Nordderby Match Center: Home to the fierce rivalry between Werder Bremen and Hamburger SV. Museum & Tours: There is a club museum and stadium tours to learn about Werder Bremen's history. title: Why Texas Stadium Names Are Changing for the World Cup
content:
Why Texas Stadium Names Are Changing for the World Cup
KCWX 2 Television
1170 subscribers

447 views
19 Apr 2026
If you’re heading to Texas for the World Cup, some familiar stadium names will look very different.

FIFA sponsorship rules prohibit non-official branding, meaning iconic venues like AT&T Stadium in Arlington will temporarily be renamed “Dallas Stadium,” while Houston’s NRG Stadium branding is also coming down.

Crews across host cities are already covering logos and signage as preparations ramp up for the FIFA World Cup 2026.

With matches just weeks away, fans can expect a different look at some of Texas’ most recognizable stadiums.
